explanation: The center is 1/2. Convergence at x=-1 guarantees convergence for |x-1/2|<3/2, which includes x=0, so I must hold. II need not hold: a_n=(2/3)^n/(n+1)^2 gives convergence at x=-1 but divergence at x=-3/2. III need not hold: a_n=1/n! gives convergence everywhere. Thus only I must be true.
